claim: Tracked top speed (p95) of the forty is highly repeatable between attempts
limitation: one drill, 10 Hz, eligible recordings only
value: ICC 0.95 [0.94, 0.96]; atlas grade Strong

claim: Speed development (time from 4 to 8 yd/s) is repeatable and only partly explained by the stopwatch
limitation: acquisition dependence uncertain; needs the 4 → 8 yd/s interval to be recorded
value: ICC 0.82 [0.78, 0.86]; R² on the stopwatch 0.65; atlas grade Provisional

claim: Peak tangential acceleration is NOT repeatable enough to describe an athlete
limitation: single-frame extremes of a 10 Hz derivative
value: ICC 0.35 [0.20, 0.49]; atlas grade Reject / not currently usable

claim: Tracked top speed is largely the same information as official testing
limitation: within position
value: R² on the stopwatch 0.87

claim: The speed-by-distance curve of a forty is low-dimensional
limitation: statistical axes, not physical quantities
value: two components explain 97.7 % of held-out curve variance (mean over 15 fold fits)

claim: TCN-B recognises an athlete's repeat attempt: a repeatable movement fingerprint
limitation: a similarity space; no dimension has a physical meaning
value: repeat-attempt retrieval AUC 0.873 [0.856, 0.890]

claim: The fingerprint still recognises the athlete among prospects with near-identical official results
limitation: repeatable is not predictive
value: matched-stopwatch retrieval AUC 0.796 [0.768, 0.824]

claim: TCN-B did NOT establish an improvement of held-out NFL sustained-acceleration prediction beyond official testing
limitation: 284 athletes; small effects are not detectable (C10); frozen conclusion of Milestone 06
value: Δ RMSE +0.0003 [-0.0008, +0.0015] (+0.16 % of the official-model error); interval includes 0

claim: NFL movement windows are dominated by context and opportunity, not by the athlete
limitation: observed context labels only
value: athlete share of within-position NFL window variance 6.3 % [5.0, 7.2]

claim: Only large incremental effects were detectable in the Milestone 06 design
limitation: planted-signal simulation on the real cohort structure
value: smallest effect detected with 80 % power — M2: planted share 0.23 of residual variance (Δ RMSE 6.7 %); M5: planted share 0.19 of residual variance (Δ RMSE 6.4 %)

claim: Recorded receiver separation is a reliable athlete-level quantity with usable linked support
limitation: vendor definition inferred; an interaction outcome; about 91 linked WR / TE
value: odd / even game reliability 0.74 [0.52, 0.87]; semantic status plausible_inferred; screen status provisional

claim: Football-outcome registry decision
limitation: a decision never raises a source class
value: FREEZE → frozen_exploratory: FO01.S0 (primary, PROVISIONAL), FO12.T2 (secondary, PROVISIONAL), FO13.K0 (secondary, PROVISIONAL)

claim: Gate B of the primary football outcome (game-split reliability and support)
limitation: reliability is not football skill
value: FO01.S0: odd / even Spearman–Brown 0.742 (lower bound 0.516); reference 0.7, floor 0.5 — met

claim: Primary football transfer comparison (engineered speed development beyond official testing)
limitation: one linked cohort of about 90 receivers
value: M2 versus M1 on FO01.S0: Δ RMSE -0.0007 [-0.0093, +0.0082], linkage permutation p 0.345 — not established (interval includes 0) (EXPLORATORY — source semantics inferred; definitions locked)

claim: Secondary football transfer comparison (TCN-B beyond official testing)
limitation: secondary: Holm-adjusted with the primary
value: M5 versus M1 on FO01.S0: Δ RMSE -0.0108 [-0.0244, -0.0001], linkage permutation p 0.886 — the tracking model is worse (interval below 0) (EXPLORATORY — source semantics inferred; definitions locked)

claim: Detectability of an incremental effect in the football cohort
limitation: planted-signal simulation on the real football cohort
value: smallest effect detected with 80 % power — M2: 80 % power not reached in the grid (max 0.60); M5: 80 % power not reached in the grid (max 0.29)

claim: Combine tracking characteristics that stay repeatable after official tests are accounted for
limitation: new measured information about the run; no football implication
value: repeatable beyond official tests: tracked top speed (p95), speed development 4 → 8 yd/s, FPCA speed-curve scores (K = 2), TCN-B movement fingerprint (8-d). Others: acceleration over 1 s from 4 yd/s (unstable); speed gain over 10 yd from 4 yd/s (weak_residual_signal)

claim: The scouting scorecard is descriptive, uncertainty-aware and abstains where evidence is missing
limitation: information support, not a proven decision gain
value: every criterion met

claim: Get-off cannot be used as an outcome
limitation: no authoritative definition in the repository
value: player_get_off: blocked_definition (source semantics unresolved)

claim: Cohort size a future study needs
limitation: resampled-cohort scenarios: sampling precision only
value: power to detect a planted share 0.05 of residual variance by cohort size — n = 84: 0.12, n = 150: 0.24, n = 284: 0.48, n = 500: 0.78, n = 1000: 1.00
